settings.heading: The slice.
settings.subheading: Every pair carries a share that isn't ours to keep.
settings.text: We cut it from our profit, never from your price, and give it to people in need.

settings.heading: Same price. A slice set aside.

settings.title: Purchase
settings.text: You buy a pair at the same price as always. Nothing is added for charity.

settings.title: Contribution allocation
settings.text: We set aside at least 5% of the profit we make on that pair, worked out on the price you finally pay.

settings.title: Verification
settings.text: Cases of need are checked by us before anything is given.

settings.title: Distribution and reporting
settings.text: The slices are pooled and given each quarter. Date, amount and the case are published on this page and on our social pages.

settings.title: How it works
settings.body: Every pair we sell carries a share that is not ours to keep. It is never a marketing budget.

settings.title: How contributions are calculated
settings.body: At least 5% of the profit we make on each pair, worked out on the price you finally pay.
settings.dev_note: The exact profit definition used for the 5% (for example after product cost, delivery and fees), before launch.

settings.title: Buyer voting
settings.body: Vote in your bag before checkout. The cause with the most votes from this quarter's buyers receives the slice.
settings.dev_note: What happens on a tie or when nobody votes in a quarter.

settings.title: Quarterly distribution
settings.body: The slices are pooled and given each quarter, so the help is large enough to matter, to one verified case of need after our own checks.

settings.title: Published record
settings.body: Date, amount and the case, on this page and on our social pages. The people we help keep their dignity.

settings.title: Charity does not decrease wealth.
settings.body:
Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, Sahih Muslim 2588.

We follow the way of the early Muslim traders: honest goods, a fair margin, and a share of every gain returned to people in need. The people we give to are our neighbours, not a campaign, and every case is treated with dignity.

settings.heading: Every pair adds to the slice.
